classification_detail.detail: A's C02 period-context full_dated_proof value and parent-history acceptance change: the incremental B02 API is now used, a qualified context reports B02_INCREMENTAL_PERIOD_API_QUALIFIED, purchase history is accepted only with matching currency, and the source chain is validated. A's two live-test assertions expecting the old B02_FULL_DATED_PROOF_HELD_PLAN_ABSENT constant are stale; A's other seven C02/live tests pass. Fresh roots only.

New C03 parent_decision.py and C04 parent_speech.py; new P4 closed operations period-materialize, market-establish, parent-decide, parent-perform, parent-speak; new C12 P2_PARENT_DECISION/P2_PARENT_ACTION/P2_PARENT_UTTERANCE episodes. Existing C02 MATERIAL_ACTIVITY event, C01/C02 readers and B02/B04/B05 modules are not rewritten.

C03 self-only prove/admit/perform/read decision/action; actual B04 purchase/owned-object consumer; C04 self-only parent utterance and child speech-uptake reader; normal P4/P6 view/say after parent operations.

B04 purchase currency conflict: B04 currently admits a purchase whose parent material currency differs from the market/request currency and declares `PARENT_MATERIAL_CASH_UNIT_AS_SOURCEFREE_CURRENCY_UNIT`. C02 refuses the admitted purchase in parent history (PARENT_PURCHASE_CURRENCY_MISMATCH) and C03 refuses the mismatch before B04. B04/B05 default tests fail at this boundary; exact required B04 ABI is returned in B04_CURRENCY_EXPECTED_ABI.md. No conversion/equivalence is invented.
C03 uses an explicit sourcefree obligation/purchase decision hypothesis, not native/MIII mother psychology, a general decision engine or an LLM backend. No CAN/ADP/Pyat/native issuance.

P3 source closure still pins only contracts.py/p2_owner.py; parent_activity.py, parent_decision.py and parent_speech.py are unpinned and must be deliberately added by the P3 owner if required. B02/B04/B05 are other-pair owned and were not edited. No protected/source/human/actor authority.

P4 normal background dispatch extensions are a closed operation enum, not an arbitrary callback or new scheduler/ledger. No new world event vocabulary was added; C04 uses the existing SPEECH event; C03 decision/action episodes are C12/owner records.
